info.name: Lago API documentation Add_ons Plans API

items.docs: This endpoint retrieves all existing plans.
This endpoint creates a plan with subscription and usage-based charges. It supports flexible billing cadence (in-advance or in-arrears) and allows for both recurring and metered charges.

params.name: code
params.description: The code of the plan. It serves as a unique identifier associated with a particular plan. The code is typically used for internal or system-level identification purposes, like assigning a subscription, for instance.
